hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE '^git commit' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"DOCS CHECK: Did you update ARCHITECTURE.md, feature docs, or CLAUDE.md if this commit added new endpoints, models, modules, or integrations?"}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE 'prisma (migrate|db push)' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"DOCS CHECK: Database schema changed. Update the Database Schema section in ARCHITECTURE.md to match."}}' || true
